test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution
solution: The correct answer is '**Abolish**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Abolish**'. • It means 'to end a law or system officially'. (किसी क़ानून या प्रथा को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्‍त करना) • *Example: When was capital punishment **abolished** here?* **Correct Answer:__** *Abolish.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Stop**: to finish moving or make something finish moving. [रुकना या (किसी को) रोकना (गतिमान न रहना या न रहने देना)] • **Destroy**: to damage something so badly that it can no longer be used or no longer exists. (किसी वस्‍तु को इस तरह हानि पहुँचाना कि वह इस्‍तेमाल न हो सके या समाप्‍त हो जाए, नष्‍ट करना) • **Kill**: to make somebody/something die. (किसी को मारना, किसी का मारा जाना) 170:T5ee, The correct answer is **'had listened'.**
